CBS_service_curve.description: Rate-latency service curve β(t) = R * [t - T]+ where R = idleSlope and T is latency term
CBS_service_curve.latency_component: T = (max_frame_size / sendSlope_magnitude) = worst-case credit accumulation time
CBS_service_curve.max_interference_per_hop: Calculated based on competing flows at each egress port

WCD_equation.general_form: WCD = Σ(propagation_delay + switching_delay + transmission_time + CBS_shaping_delay) + sync_error
WCD_equation.simplified_per_hop: hop_delay ≈ 2 + (frame_bits / bandwidth) * (1 + 1/3) for CBS with 75% idleSlope
WCD_equation.note: CBS delay factor approximated as (1/idleSlope) = 1.333 for 75% allocation

frame_size_calculation.description: Frame size = Payload + Ethernet overhead (Preamble 8B + Header 14B + VLAN 4B + CRC 4B + IFG 12B) = Payload + 38B

WCD_calculation_methodology.equation: WCD = sum(frame_tx_time_per_hop) + sum(propagation_delay_per_hop) + sum(switching_delay_per_hop) + CBS_shaping_delay + interference_delay
WCD_calculation_methodology.CBS_shaping_delay_formula: For each hop: max(0, frame_size_bits / SendSlope_bps) - (frame_size_bits / link_rate_bps)
WCD_calculation_methodology.interference_delay_formula: Sum of potential blocking from competing flows at each egress port, weighted by traffic intensity and CBS credit recovery
WCD_calculation_methodology.notes: CBS provides rate limiting via SendSlope (-25 Mbps). Shaping delay can be negative when IdleSlope (75 Mbps) allows faster transmission than base rate would permit for SR traffic. Interference calculated based on competing flows sharing same egress port and queue.

WCD_equation.description: WCD = Σ(per_hop_delay) where per_hop_delay = transmission_time + switching_delay + propagation_delay + CBS_queuing_delay
WCD_equation.CBS_queuing_delay: Worst-case credit recovery time based on SendSlope = frame_size_bits / |SendSlope_bps|
WCD_equation.simplified: For cut-through with CBS: WCD ≈ hop_count × (frame_transmission_time/IdleSlope_ratio + fixed_delays + interference_from_competing_flows)
